chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Subbah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who has a female slave for one of his children, while his children are young, is it suitable for him to have intercourse with her? He said: 'He appraises her at a fair price, then takes her, and the price becomes a debt upon him owed to his children.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a father having intercourse with a female slave owned by his minor child?
ai.summary: In the context of pre-modern Shia jurisprudence, this hadith clarifies the father's right of usufruct over a concubine owned by his minor child, ensuring the child's capital is preserved. Shaykh al-Tusi records this to illustrate the mechanism of 'taqyīm' (fair appraisal), where the father's use of the slave is treated as a debt to the child, thereby preventing the depletion of the child's inheritance. This ruling highlights the distinct property rights of minors in Shia law, where the father acts as a guardian managing assets rather than an absolute owner.
